openP1ReleaseBlockers.title: Existing OriginOS deployment target not yet reconciled to remediation head
openP1ReleaseBlockers.detail: An existing OriginOS Vercel project is known to exist, but the currently connected Vercel project listing did not expose it. Exact-head preview/runtime deployment certification therefore remains incomplete. No new project is required and workers-food-club must not be repurposed.

openP1ReleaseBlockers.title: Independent adversarial current-release review not yet captured
openP1ReleaseBlockers.detail: A bounded independent review of the current-release traceability, executable falsification, PostgreSQL certification, identity certification, deployment evidence, and semantic quarantines remains required before a release-readiness determination.

closedOrPassingGates: identity and service authorization boundary certification

supersededDeploymentAssumption.statement: A new OriginOS Vercel project is required.
supersededDeploymentAssumption.replacement: Use and reconcile the existing OriginOS Vercel project. Do not create another project solely for certification and do not repurpose workers-food-club.

releaseStatement: Residual-gap classification only. Deployment certification and independent review remain open. Production activation is unauthorized.
